items.title: Return CRS tax-residency self-certification form
items.quote: Please complete the enclosed self-certification form and send it back to us by 29 October 2025.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which the completed form must reach the bank: 29 October 2025. This is a company (bank) letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the date is used exactly as printed. 29 October 2025 falls on a Wednesday, a regular business day in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed.

warnings: The letter warns that failing to return the form by the deadline will result in the account being reported to tax authorities in both Germany and Ghana — a real consequence under CRS rules, but the person should verify this request is genuine (e.g. by calling the bank's listed number) before sending any personal tax information, since impersonation of banks for CRS/FATCA 'self-certification' is a known phishing pattern.
